name: Ground Drop
description: Video A (@nia_teppelin): Minecraft pixel font, white with a drop shadow. Words pop up a few blocks in front of you near eye level, then every letter drops and lies flat on the blocks below, following the terrain, and fades after a while. Tuned 2026-10-30: bigger and closer, like the clip. 2026-10-31: letters let go one by one and lie readable (top away from you), like the second clip.
